statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: The term "ECN marked" refers to packets with ECN code point 11, CE (Congestion Experienced); packets received with this ECN code point MUST be reported using State 1, Received ECN Marked.
actions: report packet in Ack Vector using State 1 (Received ECN Marked)

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Packets received with ECN code points 00, 01, or 10 (Non-ECT, ECT(0), or ECT(1), respectively) MUST be reported using State 0, Received.
actions: report packet in Ack Vector using State 0 (Received)

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Ack Vector MUST NOT be sent on DCCP-Data and DCCP-Request packets, which lack an Acknowledgement Number, and any Ack Vector options encountered on such packets MUST be ignored.
actions: omit Ack Vector option from DCCP-Data packets
omit Ack Vector option from DCCP-Request packets

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Ack Vector MUST NOT be sent on DCCP-Data and DCCP-Request packets, which lack an Acknowledgement Number, and any Ack Vector options encountered on such packets MUST be ignored.
statements.pre_cond: received_packet.type = DCCP-Data | received_packet.type = DCCP-Request & received_packet.has_ack_vector_option = true
actions: ignore Ack Vector options present on DCCP-Data packets
ignore Ack Vector options present on DCCP-Request packets

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: (These principles SHOULD also be followed for other acknowledgement mechanisms; referring to Ack Vector states simplifies their explanation.)

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Packets reported as State 0 or State 1 MUST be acknowledgeable: their options have been processed by the receiving DCCP stack.
actions: ensure options of packets reported as State 0 or State 1 have been processed by the receiving DCCP stack before reporting

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Packets reported as State 3 MUST NOT be acknowledgeable.
actions: ensure packets reported as State 3 are not acknowledged

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Feature negotiations and options on such packets MUST NOT have been processed, and the Acknowledgement Number MUST NOT correspond to such a packet.
actions: do not process feature negotiations on packets reported as State 3
do not process options on packets reported as State 3

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Feature negotiations and options on such packets MUST NOT have been processed, and the Acknowledgement Number MUST NOT correspond to such a packet.
actions: ensure Acknowledgement Number does not correspond to any packet reported as State 3

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Packets dropped in the application's receive buffer MUST be reported as Received or Received ECN Marked (States 0 and 1), depending on their ECN state; such packets' ECN Nonces MUST be included in the Nonce Echo.
actions: report application-receive-buffer-dropped packets as State 0 (Received) or State 1 (Received ECN Marked) depending on ECN state

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Packets dropped in the application's receive buffer MUST be reported as Received or Received ECN Marked (States 0 and 1), depending on their ECN state; such packets' ECN Nonces MUST be included in the Nonce Echo.
actions: include ECN Nonces of application-receive-buffer-dropped packets in the Nonce Echo

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: One or more Ack Vector options that, together, report the status of a packet with a sequence number less than ISN, the initial sequence number, SHOULD be considered invalid.
actions: treat Ack Vector option as invalid when it reports a sequence number less than ISN

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: The receiving DCCP SHOULD either ignore the options or reset the connection with Reset Code 5, "Option Error".
actions: ignore the invalid Ack Vector options
OR send DCCP-Reset with Reset Code 5 (Option Error)

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Packets that haven't been included in any Ack Vector option SHOULD be treated as "not yet received" (State 3) by the sender.
actions: treat packets not covered by any Ack Vector option as State 3 (not yet received) at the sender
